props.description: A funnel labeled INSIGHT pours endless books, podcasts and videos into a head-shaped vessel, but the vessel is already full and overflowing — nothing absorbs. Beside it, a smaller empty vessel cracked open by a single lived experience drinks one drop and glows. Visualizes that volume is not the constraint.
